description: This file defines an Angular Pipe named 'highlight' that wraps matching keyword text within a string with HTML <mark> tags for highlighting purposes. It implements the PipeTransform interface and is marked as standalone.

classes.name: HighlightPipe
classes.description: An Angular Pipe that highlights occurrences of a search term within a text by wrapping them in <mark> tags.

methods.name: transform(text: string | null | undefined, term: string | null | undefined): string { transform
methods.description: Transforms the input text by wrapping all case-insensitive matches of the search term with <mark> tags.

ctags.name: transform
ctags.pattern: /^  transform(text: string | null | undefined, term: string | null | undefined): string {$/
